ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Разумение» (razumeniye) is 'understanding' and «начало» (nachalo) 'source' per the project terminology, so «началом всего» (nachalom vsego) is 'the source of all' beside «источник» (istochnik, 'source'); pronouns for God are lowercase as in the Russian. Attributions: «Персидский Хейям» (Persidskiy Kheyyam) is 'the Persian Khayyam' (Omar Khayyam), and «Д’Агу» (D'Agu) is given in its French form, d'Agoult (Marie d'Agoult).
